headline: Favorites is a tab now — and a revocation always sticks
highlights: The shelf bar is one centered set of tabs with bigger targets, and the Favorites tab shows your starred tools alone — every other tab brings the whole wall back
Your favorites live only behind their tab, so the wall stops listing the same tools twice
A revocation made from the web console can no longer be silently undone by the Mac's next save — the merge folds it in and says so
